name: weighted_indicator_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, the relative predictiveness of momentum vs. mean-reversion signals rotates across intraday sessions — EMA crossovers dominate trending mornings when institutional TWAP flows are active, while RSI thresholds predict better in choppy afternoon sessions when market makers are fading extremes. This strategy tracks each indicator's recent 50-signal hit rate and applies softmax performance weighting (temperature α=2.0), automatically concentrating composite weight on whichever signal type has been most predictive in the current regime. When the weighted composite of VWAP position, 2-min RSI, MACD histogram, EMA(18/42) crossover, and OBV-vs-SMA trend exceeds 0.55 with at least 3 of 5 indicators aligned directionally, NIFTY is exhibiting coordinated multi-timescale order flow that typically sustains a 12-18 spot point move over 60-90 seconds as the dominant algorithmic flow completes its execution cycle.

indicators.name: vwap_position
indicators.purpose: VWAP is session-cumulative — no scaling needed. Acts as a regime filter: above VWAP means buy-side algo flow is dominant, below means sell-side. Preserves the original VWAP condition (close > vwap for long) and maps cleanly to NIFTY.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI (24 bars × 5s). Original was RSI(14) on 1-min bars = 14 minutes of data. Compressed to 2 minutes because our hold is 30-90 seconds — we need a trigger that fires on short-term overbought/oversold setups, not multi-minute extremes. Thresholds shifted from 35/65 (equity) to 40/60 (NIFTY index) because the smoother index rarely hits stock-level extremes.

indicators.name: macd_24_52_18
indicators.purpose: 2x scaling of MACD(12,26,9) from 1-min to 5s bars: fast=24(2min), slow=52(4.3min), signal=18(1.5min). This preserves the original ratio (fast:slow ≈ 1:2.2). The MACD histogram sign captures momentum turning points within the 2-4 minute window that correlates with institutional order flow completion on NIFTY.

indicators.name: ema_18_42
indicators.purpose: 2x scaling of EMA(9,21) from 1-min to 5s: short=18(1.5min), long=42(3.5min). Same proportional scaling as MACD — preserves the relative sensitivity. At 5s resolution, this EMA crossover detects the 1-4 minute directional bias that determines whether short-term bounces are continuation or reversal.

indicators.name: obv_vs_sma60
indicators.purpose: OBV vs its 5-minute SMA (60 bars × 5s). Original used OBV vs SMA(OBV,20) on 1-min = 20-minute context. Compressed from 20 minutes to 5 minutes because NIFTY index volume at 5s resolution is inherently noisier than equity 1-min bars; a 5-min OBV SMA gives a stable volume trend signal without over-smoothing. OBV resets at day boundaries to avoid stale accumulation contaminating intraday signal.

indicators.name: hit_rate_weights
indicators.purpose: Dynamic performance weighting — the unique core of this strategy. At each bar, each indicator's weight equals exp(α×hit_rate_k) / sum(exp(α×hit_rate_j)) where hit_rate_k = fraction of last 50 non-neutral signals from indicator k where sign(next_bar_return) matched the signal direction. α=2.0 creates meaningful weight concentration without collapsing to a single indicator. Weights adapt as regime shifts — no fixed lookback needed.

buy_ce.confirmation: Weighted composite score sustained above threshold — no 2-bar persistence required (composite already filters noise via multi-indicator breadth requirement)

buy_pe.confirmation: Weighted composite score sustained below negative threshold

entry.entry_price: limit at close of signal bar

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 spot points at delta 0.5. Entry requires 3+ aligned indicators plus VWAP direction — a high-conviction setup. If NIFTY retraces 10 spot points against this multi-indicator setup within 30-90 seconds, the coordinated flow thesis has clearly broken down. NIFTY's 1-minute typical range is 3-7 option points; using 5 gives adequate room for normal noise without absorbing a full trend reversal.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points = ~16 spot points. Multi-indicator alignment on NIFTY historically precedes 12-20 spot point sustained moves within 60-90 seconds as the dominant algo continues execution. 8 pts captures the median move with 1:1.6 R:R — aggressive enough to be meaningful, conservative enough to avoid requiring the full institutional cycle to complete.

filters.vix_filter: None (VIX data not used — VWAP already acts as regime filter)
filters.time_filter: No entries before 09:30 (first 15 min needed for VWAP establishment and hit-rate accumulation) or after 15:25
filters.volume_filter: OBV signal implicitly captures volume confirmation
filters.trend_filter: VWAP position as regime filter — long only above VWAP, short only below
filters.spread_filter: Limit order execution; no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — the dynamic weighting adapts to regime shifts, reducing decay risk relative to static composites. However, if all 5 indicators simultaneously lose predictive power (e.g., during macro shock days), the meta-learning layer cannot compensate.

adaptation_notes: Four key changes from original: (1) Universe shifted from NIFTY 50 constituent stocks to the NIFTY index itself — eliminates stock-specific risk and makes VWAP/OBV signals cleaner on the index. (2) All indicator periods compressed 2x (1-min → 5s bars), not the naive 12x, because our hold is 30-90s vs original 15-45 min — the trigger timeframe compresses proportionally. (3) RSI thresholds relaxed from 35/65 to 40/60 because NIFTY index is smoother than individual equities and rarely reaches extreme RSI levels. (4) OBV SMA window compressed from 20-min to 5-min to match our faster hold horizon while still providing meaningful volume trend context.
weaknesses: Hit-rate computation based on 1-bar-ahead (5s) direction is noisy — the actual hold is 30-90s, so the 5s hit rate may not accurately reflect 60-90s directional accuracy
During trending days, VWAP-above condition keeps strategy bullish all day — potential for correlated losses if NIFTY has a sustained intraday reversal
The 50-signal hit-rate window is fixed and may adapt too slowly to fast regime changes (e.g., post-news shock where all indicators shift predictiveness simultaneously)
